## Authors / Editors
- 朱熹 (宋朝) 撰 1130 - 1200

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The 8-*juǎn* WYG version of Zhū Xī's *Shī jí zhuàn* — the same work as [KR1c0009](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1c/KR1c0009) (which is the 20-*juǎn* SBCK photo-reprint of an early Sòng edition). The *Sòngshǐ Yìwénzhì* records the work as 20 *juǎn*; the 8-*juǎn* form is a Míng commercial-shop conflation that became the standard reading text. The Sìkù editors note that Zhū Xī, like his *Yì zhuàn*, drafted the *Shī* commentary twice — the first draft, preserved through Lǚ Zǔqiān's *Dú Shī jì* ([KR1c0017](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1c/KR1c0017)) under the citation "Mr. Zhū says" (*Zhūshì yuē* 朱氏曰), entirely accepts the *small preface*. After encountering Zhèng Qiáo 鄭樵's anti-*xù* arguments Zhū Xī revised wholesale, producing the second draft (the present text), which discards the *xù* and pursues the "ancient origin" of each ode. The work appears on this position from the date of the Chúnxī 4 (1177) preface onward.

**Abstract**

[KR1c0015](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1c/KR1c0015) is the Sìkù-edited canonical version of Zhū Xī's *Shī jí zhuàn*, the single most important Southern-Sòng *Shī* commentary and the work that defined the imperial reading of the *Classic of Poetry* from the Yuán *Yánjīng* curriculum (1313) through to the abolition of the imperial examination in 1905. The Sìkù *tíyào*'s long forensic note — establishing that Zhū Xī's 1177 self-preface still belongs to the *first* draft (which followed the *xù*), and that the present *jí zhuàn* must therefore have been completed somewhat later, after Zhū's encounter with Zhèng Qiáo — is a rare piece of *Sìkù* dating philology. The *Sìkù* editors also use the entry to settle a long-running dispute: the imperial *Huìzuǎn* (1727) prints both the Zhū Xī commentary and the *xù*-readings together precisely because the *Sìkù* editors do not regard the dispute as decidable on either side. The work survives in two distinct editions — this 8-*juǎn* WYG conflation and the 20-*juǎn* SBCK ([KR1c0009](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1c/KR1c0009)) early-Sòng print — both reproducing the same final-draft text but with different *juǎn*-divisions and the SBCK preserving the original *Shī xù biànshuō* ([KR1c0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1c/KR1c0003)) appendix. The notBefore of 1177 marks the preface; the notAfter is set to Zhū Xī's death.
